results.sql: SELECT return_flag, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, MIN(extended_price) AS min_price, MAX(extended_price) AS max_price FROM lineitem GROUP BY return_flag ORDER BY return_flag ASC

results.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM lineitem WHERE ship_day >= 2400 AND discount >= 5 AND discount <= 7 AND quantity < 24
